plain: Starting around 1979 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a researcher named Paul Bennewitz came to believe in aliens. According to the story, the Air Force fed that belief on purpose until it broke him. Podcast host Jesse Michels tells it on more than one episode. He says Richard Doty, an Air Force counterintelligence agent whose job was to protect military secrets, ran a psychological operation on Bennewitz. Michels says Bennewitz had seen an unusual craft at Kirtland Air Force Base, near his home, and was fed false information afterward. Michels also points to a document called Project Beta and to a writer named Greg Bishop. Peter Levenda, an author and researcher, tells it as well, places it in the 1980s, and stresses that it is known Doty did it. To the tellers it matters because it would show the military spreading false UFO stories to steer people away from what they had seen.
